features: TAKE ONE (OR 42) AND PASS IT AROUND: This bulk Play-Doh set is a 42-pack that comes in a great hand-out box to give out as kids party favors that are non candy treats to kids 2 years and up

SHARE THE CREATIVITY FOR ANY OCCASION: Pass around these mini Play-Doh cans as kids gifts in birthday parties, halloween trick or treat toys, goodie bag fillers, valentines, classroom prizes, and even wedding kids table activities

PLAY-DOH 1 OZ CANS IN ASSORTED COLORS: With multiples of teal, pink, purple, bright red, neon orange, yellow, neon green, bright blue, and rubine red, there's lots of color to go around in this Play-Doh bulk multipack
EASY-OPEN CONVENIENT PACKAGING: Ships in frustration-free packaging; flip the box open to reveal the Play-Doh graphic on the inside and help everyone find where the Play-Doh bulk party favors are
ORIGINAL PLAY-DOH QUALITY: A favorite since 1956, Play-Doh compound is made primarily with water, salt, and flour, and goes through vigorous testing so it’s always high quality and super fun
